10253.d: The Feldip Hills are positioned to the south of Yanille and Kandarin and southeast of the Castle Wars arena.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Feldip Hills can be accessed using a variety of ways including:
• Gnome glider to Lemantolly Undri, west Feldip Hills
• The ogre boat ride, unlocked after completing Freeing Skrach Uglogwee
• Fairy rings. Ring AKS is near the Feldip hunter area. Ring ALP is in a cave south of Jiggig. After completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift, the player can use a Pickaxe to clear a tunnel to the surface from the cave. Before there, the cave cannot be used to access the surface.
• Travel to Yanille (using, for example, a Home Teleport or the Watchtower teleport) and then walk south.
• Travel to Oo'glog lodestone using Home teleport and walk north.
• Travel to Castle Wars (using, for example, a Duelling ring) and then walk south and east.
• Teleport to South Feldip Hills and walk north and slightly east.

g.how: {{map}} on wiki page 'Feldip Hills'

10254.d: The Feldip Hunter area is a Hunter training area located just north of Oo'glog.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• A gnome glider landing can be found just north of this area. Players must have completed the One Small Favour and The Grand Tree quests to be able to use this route.
• Fairy ring code AKS lands just north of this area. Requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.
• South Feldip Hills Teleport (level 10 Magic).
• Spirit tree teleport to south Feldip Hills. Requires completion of Tree Gnome Village quest.
• Ring of duelling teleport to south Feldip Hills or Castle Wars.
• Taking the jungle eagle. Players must have completed Eagles' Peak quest.
• Teleport using the spirit larupia familiar.
• Teleport to Oo'glog lodestone and run north.
• Teleport to Warforge Dig Site via master archaeologist's outfit or dig sites map and run north-east.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Feldip Hunter area'

10283.d: The Fenkenstrain's Dungeon is a large, underground structure which consists of two larger chambers and small paths.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are many ways to travel to this cave:
# Using fairy ring code ALQ to teleport to this fairy ring. This is the fastest method of travelling to the cave.
# Teleport to the ectofuntus using an ectophial.
# Teleport to Canifis using Kharyrll Teleport, or a POH portal.
# Use a charter ship to travel to Port Phasmatys. This is the slowest method and costs between 1,300 - 4,100 coins.
# Travel to the Paterdomus temple and head through the holy barrier into Morytania.
# Travel to the Canifis lodestone using the Home Teleport spell.

10285.d: Fenmoor is a boggy region on the island Havenhythe, inhabited by bogolins, a race similar to goblins adapted to life in the swamp.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Stonevein amulet Fox, located south in Fenmoor.
• Home teleport to Wendlewick and take a canoe to either:
• Amberfell 4, then head south-east through Moonsylvar Wood.
• Heathervein 5, traverse the River crossing (63 Agility) and Slippery stone (73 Agility), run south.
• Linbog Village 6, located in north Fenmoor.
• Fairy ring code DIQ and head west (must first be repaired with 5 bogwart mushrooms and requires 79 Agility).
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell (next to Ash).
• # Head south-east past Berylbrook, through Moonsylvar Wood.
• # Walk east.

• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell (next to Ash).
• # Head south-east past Berylbrook, through Moonsylvar Wood.
• # Walk east.
• Stonevein amulet teleport to the fox mural, then run north. The fox mural must be partially restored first.

10333.d: A fertile soil patch is a special patch on Anachronia where seeds dropped from vile blooms can be planted for Farming experience.
10333.ex: You can use a special type of seed here.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The patch is on the eastern side of Anachronia. Options to reach the patch include:
• Ancient seed teleport to the entrance of Herby Werby, heading south around the ruined temple and then east of the liverworts. 
• Eastern Anachronia Teleport, heading north-east through the narrow valley on lower ground.
• From Anachronia Base Camp, exiting the camp to the north then heading directly east.
• From Anachronia Base Camp, taking the Anachronia Agility Course to the north and following the route until reaching the ruined temple section south of Herby Werby. Then heading south past the ruined temple and then east of the liverworts.
